fullPassage:
Dear Mr. Johnson,
Have you "settled into" your new job by now, and do you still feel as enthusiastic about it as you did at the beginning? Of course, any job has its tiresome tasks, but all in all, from what you told us, it sounds like a good match for you. We're writing to ask when we can expect repayment of the $1,500 loan for your car. We were glad to help you with the purchase of your car so that you'd have transportation back and forth to your new job. You agreed to pay all, or at least half, of the loan by June. If you have decided that you cannot repay the total $1,500 at once, we understand. But we do need to receive at least half that amount within the next 2 or 3 weeks. We hope you are satisfied with the car you chose. We, too, thought it was a good buy. Please let us know how things are going.
Sincerely,
Joseph Brown
Financial Advisor

questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 buy의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은? (A) / (B)

det.korean: (A) buy = 매물, 좋은 거래 / (B) buy = 수긍하다, 믿다
det.analysis:
① 구매 / 수긍하다: (A)에서 buy는 명사로 a good buy = 좋은 매물이지, 구매(동사)가 아님

② 매물 / 수긍하다 ←정답: (A) a good buy = 좋은 매물(명사), (B) don't buy his excuse = 그의 변명을 수긍하지 않다

③ 구매 / 획득하다: (A) 구매(동사)는 맞지 않고, (B) 획득은 buy의 의미와 다름

④ 매물 / 획득하다: (B)에서 don't buy는 믿지 않다는 뜻이지 획득이 아님
det.tip: a good buy = 좋은 매물 / don't buy = 수긍하지 않다

det.korean: paying back money that has been borrowed = repayment(상환)
det.analysis:
① loan(대출): 돈을 빌려주는 행위이지, 갚는 행위가 아님

② investment(투자): 이익을 위해 돈을 투입하는 것

③ repayment(상환) ←정답: 빌린 돈을 되갚는 행위

④ interest(이자): 대출에 대한 추가 비용

questions.passage: We were glad to help you with the __________ (purchasing) of your car so that you'd have transportation back and forth to your new job.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: purchasing(동명사) → purchase(명사): the + ___ 구조는 명사형 필요
det.analysis: the + 명사 자리이므로 동명사 purchasing을 명사 purchase로 변환. 관사(the) 뒤에는 명사형이 적절하다.

questions.passage: Have you "settled into" your new job by now, and do you still feel as __________ (enthusiasm) about it as you did at the beginning?
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: enthusiasm(명사) → enthusiastic(형용사): feel as ___ as 구조에서 형용사 필요
det.analysis: feel as ___ as 구조는 형용사 보어가 필요하므로 명사 enthusiasm을 형용사 enthusiastic으로 변환.

questions.passage:
Dear Mr. Johnson,
Have you "settled into" your new job by now, and do you still feel as enthusiastic about it as you did at the beginning? Of course, any job has its tiresome tasks, but all in all, from what you told us, it sounds like a good match for you. We're writing to ask when we can expect __________ of the $1,500 loan for your car. We were glad to help you with the purchase of your car so that you'd have transportation back and forth to your new job. You agreed to pay all, or at least half, of the loan by June. If you have decided that you cannot repay the total $1,500 at once, we understand. But we do need to receive at least half that amount within the next 2 or 3 weeks. We hope you are satisfied with the car you chose. We, too, thought it was a good buy. Please let us know how things are going.
Sincerely,
Joseph Brown
Financial Advisor
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: repayment(상환) — $1,500 대출금의 상환 시기를 묻는 맥락
det.analysis:
① extension(연장): 대출 연장을 기대한다는 문맥이 아님

② cancellation(취소): 대출 취소가 아니라 상환을 요청하는 글

③ forgiveness(면제): 대출금 면제가 아니라 상환을 요청하는 내용

④ repayment(상환) ←정답: expect ___ of the $1,500 loan에서 대출금 상환 시기를 묻는 맥락

det.korean: amount(금액) — 최소한 절반의 금액을 받아야 한다는 맥락
det.analysis:
① interest(이자): 이자가 아니라 대출 원금의 절반을 요청하는 맥락

② penalty(벌금): 벌금 언급은 글의 어조와 맞지 않음

③ amount(금액) ←정답: receive at least half that ___에서 앞서 언급된 $1,500의 절반 금액을 의미

④ profit(이익): 이익이 아니라 대출 상환금을 말하는 맥락
